positive_control.meaning: current-source F-GC44 build and real-SWAP/live-MODFLOW baseline completed before DSW22

conclusions: The DSW22 hypothesis that all nine configured predictors initialize successfully is falsified at the first matrix point.
The failure is inside the real SWAP predictor whole-window execution before F-GC30 response assembly, F-GC40 aggregation, or F-GC33 HCOF/RHS transformation.
Because the F-GC44 positive control passed immediately beforehand, this is not a generic build or coupling-backend failure.
The original DSW22 matrix and all-success gate must not be retuned or relabeled as passed.
